items.title: Half of Cyberpunk 2's Quest Team Are Former Modders, Says Associate Game Director
items.summary: CDPR's Paweł Sasko called modding a "foot-in-the-door technique and a gateway into gamedev."
items.content:
CDPR's Paweł Sasko called modding a "foot-in-the-door technique and a gateway into gamedev."

Cyberpunk 2 A ssociate Game Director Paweł Sasko reveals that h alf of the quest team at CD PROJEKT RED are former modders.

In a recent livestream on the official CDPR YouTube channel, held on October 21, which was dedicated to the new Cyberpunk 2077 update inspired by the second season of the anime Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , Sasko expressed his support for modding, calling it a "foot-in-the-door technique and a gateway into gamedev," and shared that many of CDPR's current developers previously created mods: " We actually hired so many modders. I would say, at this point, half of the quest team is all former modders."

"Modding community is really keeping the game alive," Sasko said. "I'm very often looking at what our modders are doing, what they're building. It's very exciting. There's so much creativity, and we, as a studio, always tried to support our modding community as much as we could."

The stream also touched on updates for Cyberpunk 2077, including cross-platform mod support for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S.

You can watch the full REDstream episode below:

Last year, CDPR expanded its teams working on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 . Previously, the developer said that Cyberpunk 2 was in pre-production. The sequel to Cyberpunk 2077, initially codenamed Project Orion, was unveiled in October 2022 and is being developed with Unreal Engine 5 by a North American division comprising studios in Boston and Vancouver.

Cyberpunk 2077 is CDPR's top-performing title with over 40 million copies sold . It is getting a standalone VR experience , co-developed by CDPR and Zero Latency VR, and a live-action film adaptation , which is in development at Paramount.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 Update Secretly Added The Witcher 3 Sword and Cosmetics
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077’s surprise 2.5 update added a new dual-wielding playstyle, fresh ways to customize protagonist V’s look, extra quests and plenty more, but players have discovered that developer CD Projekt Red secretly added a range of new The Witcher 3-themed cosmetics, too.
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2077 ’s surprise 2.5 update added a new dual-wielding playstyle, fresh ways to customize protagonist V’s look, extra quests and plenty more, but players have discovered that developer CD Projekt Red secretly added a range of new The Witcher 3-themed cosmetics, too.

The Cyberpunk 2077: Edgerunners update snuck in some sweet new clothes for V to wear, as well as the professor spectacles Geralt can wear in The Witcher 3.

As mentioned by @SynthPotato on X / Twitter, you can access the items at V’s apartment once you get a text from Arianne about a gift. It’s a similar method used for other drops added to the game.

@SynthPotato They also added this knife that you missed (similar one Geralt uses to collect trophies in TW3) https://t.co/aWH0XwerMS

None of this was included in the official Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 patch notes , which mostly focused on the Edgerunners crossover and a new questline featuring Night City founder Richard Night. Those new Glamdocs look nice though — I’ve always wanted to pimp my chrome and add some color to those gorilla arms.

The Cyberpunk: Edgerunners anime just got its second season. Set after the events of the game , Edgerunners 2 features a cast of fresh characters as they navigate the dystopian hell of Night City’s corporation-ruled future. Game director Hideo Kojima made a cheeky cameo in it.

CDPR has also partnered with Paramount to make a live-action movie based on the game. However, the Cyberpunk 2077 movie won’t retrace the game’s steps . Smile 2 star Kyle Gallner said he would love to play V , though the news that it won’t follow the games could mean V doesn’t even exist in the movie.

CDPR had ruled out Cyberpunk 2077 DLC, so this 2.5 update came as a welcome surprise. Some fans still want a Cyberpunk 2077 expansion , though, and are encouraged by The Witcher 3's upcoming expansion, Songs of the Past, which arrives 12 years after the base game launched. Meanwhile, Cyberpunk 2 is in development, as is The Witcher 4 and a number of other games.

items.title: CORSAIR Drops Cyberpunk 2077 & Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Collections
items.summary: CORSAIR has created new gaming accessory collections for Cyberpunk 2077 and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.
items.content:
Posted in: CORSAIR , Cyberpunk 2077 , Pop Culture , Technology | Tagged: cyberpunk 2077 , Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2

CORSAIR has created new gaming accessory collections for Cyberpunk 2077 and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

CORSAIR has partnered with CD Projekt Red and Netflix to create two new gaming collections, one for Cyberpunk 2077 and one for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 . As you can see from the images below, they have created a customized look for the game and the show, with the Cyberpunk 2077 : Arasaka White Collection bringing back last year's sought-after Arasaka Edition lineup in the megacorp's signature white and red aesthetic, while the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Collection shows off the anime with a bit of teal thrown into the mix. Each of them offers at least a keyboard, mouse, and a mousepad. We have more info on both below, as all of the items are up for pre-order now.

Night City is built on the tech created by Arasaka, and the Arasaka White Collection looks like it came straight from the megacorp's labs. Every surface carries the Arasaka touch, from keycap legends lifted from the game's UI and the Arasaka insignia to the iconic Mantis Blades schematics spread across the deskmat. This year, the lineup adds a matching headset to complete the set.

Roman Carax is rarely seen without his vintage video camera, which he uses to capture the real, human stories within Night City. The Edgerunners 2 Collection is made in Roman's image, with vibrant colors drawn from his character design and details inspired by the recording gear he depends on. Nods to SoftSys, the repair chain that keeps his gear running, and to Roman himself appear throughout the lineup.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2 lead confirms “half of the quest team” are modders as CDPR strives to continue supporting the next generation of modding
items.summary: CD Projekt Red confirms that the Cyberpunk 2 quest team largely consists of modders as they push to support the next generation of modding.
items.content:
Games Blog About Us Careers Tutorials FAQs All News Features Guides Reviews Fortnite Marvel Rivals Arc Raiders Tutorials FAQs Cyberpunk 2 lead confirms “half of the quest team” are modders as CDPR strives to continue supporting the next generation of modding Published:

CD Projekt Red’s Cyberpunk 2 is years away from release, but fans are still eagerly awaiting the upcoming sequel. As it turns out, a significant number of fans are also actively working on the game with half of the game’s quest team consisting of modders.

Right now, Cyberpunk 2 is still in pre-production with the game’s concepts continually evolving within CDPR’s new Boston studio. While the game appears to be taking the same first-person-only stance as the original , we have no idea what the game’s narrative hook will be.

With that said, Cyberpunk 2 associate game director and former quest design lead on Cyberpunk 2077 confirmed in a recent livestream that much of the new game’s quest team consists of modders from previous CDPR games.

Sasko explained that modding is still “a foot-in-the-door technique, and a gateway into game dev”. While Cyberpunk 2 is moving from RedEngine to Unreal Engine 5 , modders showed how to make content that fits the world and vibe of the RPG franchise, which was invaluable to CDPR’s new studio.

“You can see and you can learn how things are made—how things can be built,” Sasko continued. “We actually hired so many modders [for Cyberpunk 2]. I would say, at this point, half of the quest team is all former modders.”

Sasko explained that these modders aren’t just from Cyberpunk 2077, but prior games as well. “They were are modders before of The Witcher 3, Witcher 2, you know, before we hired them and they’re part of our company, and it’s a wonderful way to actually start your career and really learn and see how to actually built those things.”

For CDPR, this is why modding is so important with the studio hoping to continue supporting modders into the future. If their games support modding and help create new generations of modders, then they’ve in turn created the next generation of CDPR developers as well.

“That’s just another thing that really excited me,” he said. “That we can keep kind of pushing this thing and make it more available for more players.”

The Witcher and Cyberpunk games are not games that require mods to be enjoyed, but modders have created some truly spectacular experiences for both. (I’m proud to announce myself as a strong lover of The Witcher 3 cloaks mods which give Geralt unparalleled pizzaz).

With that said, mods bring additional longevity to pretty much every game that supports modding, and Cyberpunk specifically has hugely benefitted from the work of modders. From new missions to perks and skill tree reworks, it’s understandable why many only play CDPR’s iconic RPG with mods enabled, and hiring those incredible creators is a great step towards creating an unforgettable sequel.

Lewis White is a veteran games journalist with over a decade in the field. Starting with beloved Xbox website ICXM/XboxMAD, Lewis became the Gaming Editor at MSPoweruser before becoming the Editor in Chief of StealthOptional and Gfinityesports. Lewis later jumped to By Gamers For Gamers where he jumped to become EIC of VideoGamer and the host of the New VideoGamer Podcast prior to the website’s acquisition.

Over the years, Lewis has also seen long-form investigative pieces published in outlets such as Eurogamer, PCGamesN, Wireframe, Retro Gamer, Nintendo Life, and EDGE. Now, as the Editor in Chief of FRVR Blog, Lewis strives to bring the same level of quality journalism with interview-led content to the site in both written and audio form with the FRVR Podcast.

With a First Degree BA Hons in Games Journalism and Public Relations, Lewis has been a stable part of the British games press for over a decade, and has frequently displayed his love of Halo, The Elder Scrolls, Fallout, and other games pretty much everywhere he’s worked. And FRVR is no different.

The game has also evolved well beyond video games at this point, with projects like Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , not to mention merchandise and numerous collaborations, too. Cyberpunk 2077 has officially teamed up with GUNNAR Optiks for a new collection of gaming eyewear inspired by the futuristic world of Night City. The Arasaka model is priced at $99 , featuring the company's distinctive black-and-red color scheme and officially licensed Cyberpunk 2077 branding.

Each pair also comes with a collection of accessories, including an Arasaka-branded metal case, microfiber pouch and cleaning cloth. The collection also includes glasses based on Dexter DeShawn and Militech. The officially licensed collaboration features GUNNAR’s lens technology designed to reduce digital eye strain while incorporating aesthetics directly inspired by characters and corporations from CD Projekt Red ’s universe.

In response, developers are paying tribute to the legendary RPG studio online, with many calling its games pivotal to their own creative paths.

17-year BioWare veteran and longtime director Michael Gamble shared the studio's news post. "Your support has meant everything to me over the past 17 years at BioWare," he writes.

New Bungie head Josh Deane replied to Gamble's post, saying, "Thank you and to everyone at Bioware who has built worlds that have been such an important part of our lives." In a separate post , Deane adds, "This studio is magical and an existential part of my favorite gaming memories, I refuse to believe this..."

CD Projekt Red veteran Paweł Sasko, a face of the studio to many fans of Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher, says "Baldur's Gate 1 and 2 shaped my imagination and the desire to create games. I would have never been here without BioWare igniting the fire in my heart. It inspired me, formed me, enriched my imagination, and for that I will be forever grateful. I will always remember you."

CDPR co-CEO Michał Nowakowski adds , "Bioware has been a massive part of CDPR history. We befriended them when localizing and selling Baldur's Gate games in Poland, Czech, and Slovakia. And later they were [a] great help when lending us their engine for Witcher 1, sharing their wisdom and even giving us a spot at their booth at E3.

Very sad for the people affected, but also sad to see a legendary brand go down. Not a great day in the games industry."

Gamble responded to Nowakowski's post, saying, "Thanks Michal. We've always been fans of you guys. Always will be."

InXile Entertainment head Brian Fargo also commented on the original Baldur's Gate games. "We saw the promise in what they could do," he says of BioWare's days on Shattered Steel, "and they went on to create Baldur's Gate 1 and 2 and become legendary. A sad day indeed. My thoughts are with everyone there today."

Mortal Kombat's Ed Boon is of a similar mind. "Very sorry to hear. They made some amazing games," he says of BioWare's shutdown statement.

Comms director Thomas Puha of Control and Alan Waker studio Remedy sums up the thoughts of many: "RIP BioWare. This was coming but so sad to read. The growing problem for large publishers is that smaller AAA games won’t bring enough money so can’t take the risk on them, but not doing original games? We need those, need new franchises."

Walker suggests the studio's closure is "the result of about 15 years of problems piling up," including consecutive commercial failures, mismanagement, and increased scrutiny from an EA team staring down billions in debt post-buyout.

items.title: 'Cyberpunk 2077' is getting a huge new co-op mod
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a new co-op mod this week that lets up to eight players team up.
items.content:
By Elijah Gonzalez Published Oct 21, 2026, 12:38 PM EDT Elijah is a freelance news writer at Polygon. He was an associate editor at The A.V. Club and Paste, and has been featured in outlets like Game Informer, Fanbyte, Unwinnable, and more. He loves media in all forms, from fighting games and horror flicks to slow cinema and visual novels. He's from the Greater Boston area. News Up to eight players can sow chaos in NightCoop

Image: CD Projekt Red Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Cyberpunk 2077 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Night City is having a busy week. Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a major 2.5 update on Oct. 22, coinciding with the recent release of the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime. CD Projekt Red just confirmed what’s in 2.5, including new quests, a perk that enables dual wielding, console mod support, and more. However, the game is arguably getting an even bigger update through unofficial channels: Cyberpunk 2077 is receiving multiplayer co-op support via the NightCoop mod.

NightCoop is a fan-made mod that lets up to eight players take on Night City together. A recently released trailer dives into the details, immediately tackling edge cases that almost certainly gave the mod’s programmers a headache. NightCoop will synchronize the world of Cyberpunk 2077 so combat and stealth work seamlessly for all players. This even applies when a partner activates their Sandevistan to slow time, causing others to see them moving with an afterimage like in the anime.

As for choices and dialogue, these are put to a vote, with the majority choice playing out for all players. The trailer culminates in a duo carrying out a heist, with one operating cameras and drones and the other leading a frontal assault. After closed tests, the mod enters open beta on Oct. 23 at 11 a.m. EDT.

According to NightCoop’s website , the mod will also support PvP, which can be toggled by the host. Player-versus-player shootouts will take into account both combatants’ stats and gear, but will even out damage between those of different levels. To set up the mod, players install NightCoop and the library RED4ext . Then the host loads an existing save or creates a new co-op game, and guests join the host’s game as their own V.

CD Projekt Red has long supported fan-modding efforts , taking the unusual step of adding mod support to the console releases of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and now Cyberpunk 2077 . The game’s RED4ext modding library has a whopping 12.6 million downloads on Nexus Mods, showing just how popular player-made additions have been .

items.title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2, New on Netflix, Confirms a Popular Fan Theory From 2077
items.summary: In Netflix's Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2, a popular fan theory from Cyberpunk 2077 has been confirmed. Let’s talk about cyberpsychosis…
items.content:
Full spoilers follow for Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 , which is available now on Netflix.

When Cyberpunk Edgerunners premiered in 2022 , fans discovered a phenomenal season of television. Not only was it one of the best sci-fi shows of all time, but also a prime example of a video game adaptation done right, with just enough connections to the source material that they don’t impact the show’s story but still provide some nods for longtime fans. More importantly, it captured the essence of CD Projekt Red’s Cyberpunk 2077 , from its themes to its world, while also delivering an emotionally devastating story through stunning visuals — and a whole lot of brutal violence.

Edgerunners 2, which is designed as a standalone sequel series, does things a bit differently. This season still offers high levels of gore and violence, incredible animation, and themes of the evil of corporations and how they destroy everything they touch. What it does differently is incorporate into its plot not only the story of the first season of Edgerunners, but even elements from Cyberpunk 2077. That’s because a big part of Edgerunners 2 deals with Soulkiller, a program introduced in Cyberpunk 2077 as capable of digitizing the mind of a person and storing it on a chip. When inserted in another person, the digital entity from the chip slowly takes over its host and eventually kills the body’s original mind. Though it is very much a death sentence, fans of the game have long theorized that there might be an unintentional side benefit to Soulkiller — namely, a cure for cyberpsychosis.

In the world of the show and game, cyberpsychosis is a dissociative disorder that affects humans who have replaced much of their organic bodies with cybernetics. As the body rejects the chrome parts, cyberpsychosis starts to affect their minds, to the point where they no longer see themselves as people, but rather as machines with replaceable parts. This disorder manifests as an outburst where the victim disassociates and becomes violent, their brain taken over by hallucinations. In the world of Edgerunners, cyberpsychosis is portrayed as something unavoidable, a forgone conclusion the moment you start replacing your body with cybernetics. You can’t prevent it, and you can’t stop it.

But what if you can? According to a popular fan theory, the main character of Cyberpunk 2077, V, never experiences cyberpsychosis because of their interaction with the chip containing the Soulkiller program. It is the digitized entity within the chip that heals V’s emerging cyberpsychosis, as it is programmed to prepare its host body in order to take over it. Without the chip and the Soulkiller entity, V would succumb to cyberpsychosis.

We see this happen in the second half of Edgerunners 2. This season, we’re introduced to Talia, a young woman suffering from a serious if undisclosed illness. Additionally, Talia’s cybernetic implants have her on the verge of cyberpsychosis, with a doctor saying she will be lost at any minute. And yet, the moment she comes in contact with a chip containing a Soulkiller entity known as Capri, Talia’s health improves significantly and at an abnormal rate. Her brain is healed, her body is repaired, and cyberpsychosis is no longer an issue — until the chip is eventually removed and Talia reverts back to how she was, with her future uncertain.

Granted, Soulkiller is portrayed in Edgerunners as more of a weapon than anything else. Capri is described as an amalgamation of different digital constructs, which seems more like an AI made out of several individuals rather than a single one. She’s designed specifically to be the ultimate killing machine, but in addition to destroying her host body’s previous consciousness, the test subjects all die within days of getting the Capri chip inserted. This is why the Arasaka Corporation was going after people like Talia and David from Season 1, as they are known to have a high tolerance for cybernetics.

Returning to Cyberpunk 2077 or playing it for the first time? We’ve got a new and improved Cyberpunk interactive map to help you find every mission, Iconic item, and collectible in the game. Plus, we’ve also got a full walkthrough for the base game, a Phantom Liberty walkthrough , and an overview of all the Cyberpunk 2077 endings so you don’t make a choice you regret. And we can’t ignore the various romance options you can smooch, which also impact how V’s story concludes.

Cyberpunk Edgerunners Season 2 takes a different approach to adapting the world of Cyberpunk 2077. Though still very much an original story, this season is more intrinsically connected to the game; it feels more like a side story happening during the events of the game that the player simply didn’t get to witness. The use of the Soulkiller program serves to connect the show and the game in an interesting way without taking away from either of the separate stories. Instead, knowing the larger story of the Soulkiller from Cyberpunk 2077 makes the story of Talia and Capri hit harder because it’s one of countless similar stories in Night City.

Sure, this season doesn’t have a story as emotionally resonant as David’s from the first season, but it still very much tells an effective tale about people who get screwed by corporations. Talia may come from a family of money and power, but that can’t save her. Night City devours everyone and everything within it, and there’s no winning in that place… Though having a Soulkiller chip might help a bit if you are on the verge of cyberpsychosis.

To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

Because legends don’t fade.

items.title: Patch 2.31
items.summary: Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live! This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below: Vehicles Updated Aut
items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]
